rules.title: Mutable default argument
rules.description: def f(x=[]) or x={} — the default is shared across calls. Use None + init in body.

rules.title: Bare or swallowed except
rules.description: except: / except Exception: pass — hides bugs including KeyboardInterrupt. Catch specific exceptions and handle or re-raise.

rules.title: SQL built by string formatting
rules.description: f-strings or % formatting building SQL with variables — injection risk. Use parameterized queries.

rules.title: Resource not closed
rules.description: open(), socket, or connection without with/try-finally — leaks handles on exceptions.

rules.title: Mutable module-level state
rules.description: Module-level mutable globals written by functions — hidden coupling, test pollution, thread hazards.
